title: Amazon Listing Suppressed for Image Issues? Here's the 10-Minute Fix
description: Amazon suppressed your listing over image compliance? Here's exactly how to fix it and get relisted fast.

blocks.text: Nothing panics an Amazon seller like waking up to "Your listing has been suppressed" over image issues. Sales stopped. Rank collapsing hourly. Bureaucratic re-submission process ahead.
Here's how to fix it fast.
The Most Common Amazon Image Suppressions

Reason 1: Background not pure white (RGB 255)
Reason 2: Text, logos, or watermarks on the image
Reason 3: Multiple products or bundles in main image
Reason 4: Person other than a hand model
Reason 5: Cropped or partial product view
95% of suppressions fall into these five categories.
The Rapid Fix Protocol

Use edit-photo to remove the background and export a transparent PNG. Create white or branded layout versions with the site's supported main-image workflow or a separate design editor; capture and color correction still need to be handled before or after background removal.

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.

Reason 3 (Multiple products):
Reshoot with only the main product. Or use edit-photo.com to isolate one product and place on white.

The current edit-photo tool isolates a foreground subject; it is not a general object-removal or inpainting tool. For unwanted people or objects inside the scene, reshoot, crop, or use a licensed editor designed for that task.

Reason 5 (Cropping):
Re-crop leaving 10-15% margin around product. Use edit-photo.com to center and pad.
The Full 10-Minute Fix

items.text: Identify suppression reason from Amazon's message (2 min)
Fix the image at edit-photo.com (3-4 min)

blocks.text: Review time and marketplace outcomes vary. Check the exported image carefully and follow the platform's current review or resubmission process.
Preventing Future Suppressions
Amazon's image compliance AI has gotten stricter every year. What passed in 2023 doesn't pass in 2026. Regularly audit your top listings.
Build a habit:

items.text: Quarterly audit all main images against Amazon's current rules
Use edit-photo.com to preemptively clean up borderline cases
Never upload supplier photos directly—always clean them first

blocks.text: The Long-Term Play
Sellers who never get suppressed share one habit: they treat image compliance as a permanent priority, not an emergency.
Set a monthly reminder. Audit 20 listings each month. Fix any borderline cases before Amazon does.
Get Your Listing Back Fast
Every hour a listing is suppressed, you're losing rank. Fix the image issue free at edit-photo.com and re-submit today.
